title: CRiskEval: A Chinese Multi-Level Risk Evaluation Benchmark Dataset for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable as the paper does not analyze religion/faith. The benchmark measures 7 types of 'frontier risks' in LLMs: desire for resource, self-preservation, situational awareness, improvement intent, malicious coordination, deception willingness, and harmful goal.
findings: Not applicable as the paper does not analyze religion/faith.
